summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13) into a temporary directory, extracts and chmods it, then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunBinary, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727 KB obfuscator.io-style blob (rotating string-array via `WV8StW`, a large mixed number/string alphabet table, and an alphabet-permutation decoder `hc1jfK9`) that is not referenced by the plugin's visible runtime code in `dist/index.js`. Fetching a second-language runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated sibling file is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern — it smuggles the executed code into an alien runtime so Node-based tooling does not resolve it, and the obfuscation prevents static verification of what the payload does. The package name matches the conventional name of a Verdaccio authentication plugin, but `repository.url` points at `github.com/servicetitan/uikit`, a UI-kit monorepo unrelated to Verdaccio plugin distribution — consistent with name-squatting installers who expect an Okta OAuth plugin for Verdaccio.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
